regressionNote: No changes since last audit (a65dbf0). File is unchanged.
summary: Minimal Solidity interface mirroring the on-chain Curve Router NG (0x16C6521Dff6baB339122a0FE25a9116693265353). Exposes only the `exchange()` function used by CurveAMMAdapter. The router is an external, unmodifiable dependency.

externalEntryPoints.function: exchange(address[11] _route, uint256[5][5] _swap_params, uint256 _amount, uint256 _expected, address[5] _pools, address _receiver) payable returns (uint256)
externalEntryPoints.notes: Pulls _amount of _route[0] from msg.sender. Delivers output to _receiver. payable because some routes involve ETH. _expected is slippage floor.

trustAssumptions: Router is the canonical Curve Router NG at the configured address.
Router pulls exactly _amount of input token from the caller.
Router delivers at least _expected output tokens to _receiver.
Router does not re-enter the caller during exchange().
